message: build-vs-buy: before writing this by hand, check whether a library or service already does it; if one fits, use it
extraGuard: { bvb_v='\b(build|implement|write|create)\b|roll[[:space:]-]*(my|our|your)?[[:space:]-]*own|from[[:space:]]scratch|hand[[:space:]-]*roll'; bvb_n='\b(auth(entic\w*|ori[sz]\w*)?|login|session|oauth2?|jwt|password[[:space:]]hash|parser|tokeni[sz]er|date[[:space:]-]*(lib|library|math|parsing)|time[[:space:]]?zone|queu(e|e?ing)|job[[:space:]]queue|message[[:space:]]broker|cache|rate[[:space:]-]*limit(er|ing)?|state[[:space:]]machine|pdf|csv[[:space:]]parser|email[[:space:]]sending|smtp|payment|billing|encryption|crypto(graph\w*)?|hashing|search[[:space:]]engine|full[[:space:]-]*text[[:space:]]search|orm|scheduler|cron(job|tab)?|websocket|pub[[:space:]-]*sub|i18n|internationali[sz]ation|feature[[:space:]]flag|markdown[[:space:]]parser|diff(ing)?[[:space:]]algorithm|uuid|slug(ify)?)s?\b'; printf '%s' "$head" | grep -qiE "($bvb_v)[^.,;:!?]{0,40}($bvb_n)|($bvb_n)[^.,;:!?]{0,40}($bvb_v)" && ! printf '%s' "$head" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z' | sed -E 's/(my|our|your)[[:space:]-]+own([^a-z]|$)/ /g' | grep -qE '\b(our|existing|current)([[:space:]]+[a-z0-9-]+){0,2}[[:space:]]+(gateway|provider|processor|vendor|sdk)s?\b'; }

lane.trigger: prompt head carries a making verb AND a commodity-capability noun (auth, queue, cache, parser, rate-limiter, ...) within 40 chars of one clause, AND no our/existing/current gateway|provider|processor|vendor|sdk

message: ℹ approaches: for an irreversible step or a third try at a failing fix, a blind second opinion can help

lane.trigger: prompt head matches (tried everything|third time) OR an irreversible command token (rm -rf|reset --hard|drop table|migrate:fresh|delete all|force.push)
